name: panda_pick
description: Pick up one currently visible graspable object using its Ego-State target reference. The body's pick skill binds the selected identity, derives its policy instruction, observes lift and confirms stopping. A successful pick keeps holding the object. No automatic retry.
requires: The body is libero-panda and supports pick; args.target is a fresh graspable object id from this episode's ego_state or ego_query; the gripper is not already holding another object.
ensures: Returns the same Job's id, state, goalStatus, stopStatus and evidence after succeeded/achieved/confirmed, otherwise throws with the terminal result. Does not claim placement success.

parameters.target: Current Ego-State id of the selected graspable object
